system.description: • Effect: At-will, as your action, create a harmless, momentary visual or sound distraction within 30ft — no save, no mechanical effect beyond what the GM rules, but usable to feint, mask a small sound or object, or grant advantage on a single Stealth check per encounter.

activities.name: Minor Figment
activities.text: Create a harmless momentary sight or sound within 30ft to feint, mask a small sound or object, or aid one Stealth check per encounter.
